biochemMachines.title: Machines and assets · Biochem
biochemMachines.subtitle: Every machine and asset of the company, grouped by kind · each has an ID, its place, and its maintenance and calibration dates · production entries and lab results pick machines from here
biochemMachines.dialogHint: The place and first calibration date are set when the machine is added; later moves and calibrations are recorded as events.
biochemMachines.emptyBody: Add the machines of each line, the scales and the lab instruments with their calibration interval.

doc.title: Documents
doc.uploadLater: Uploading invoices, warranties and certificates needs a private document store for assets, which is not set up yet.

identity.title: Identity
identity.body: asset ID, name, make, model, serial number, purchase date and cost.

where.title: Where it works
where.body: the line or place; moves are recorded as events.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.body: service, repair, breakdowns and AMC, with amounts.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.body: for scales, meters and lab instruments: result, agency and next due.

depreciation.title: Depreciation
depreciation.body: life and residual value are set with the CA.

scales.title: Scales and lab instruments
scales.body: A scale or instrument past its calibration date can't be used for weighing in a production entry or for a lab result. A failed calibration takes it out of service until it passes again.
